chitin-chimera.summary: A low-poly toy translation of the chitinous multi-eyed dragon, built from stacked carapace segments, spiky limbs, and horned crests.
chitin-chimera.pose: Splayed low in an armored quadrupedal crouch with neck arched backward snarling toward the left perimeter.

quill-spires.summary: A cluster of angular, faceted crystalline quill cones emerging from a low base plate, echoing the creature's bristling arm spines.

ribbed-plates.summary: Tiered horizontal curved plates stacked like chitinous exoskeleton ridges on the ground.

carapace-crest.summary: A towering bone-chitin horn with stepped jagged serrations along its rear spine.

tail-pinnacle.summary: An arching curled chitin segment segmented by interlocking bead joints.

things.text: A flake of calcified chitin, cold from the shale shelf.
